summary:
默沙東本季虧損但優於預期13%，營收年增4.9%顯示一次性項目衝擊獲利。
• 每股虧損1.28美元，優於預期虧損1.47美元，超預期幅度13.15%
• 營收162.9億美元，年增4.87%，本業營收仍維持成長
• 虧損可能源於併購或研發里程碑等一次性費用，非本業惡化
• Keytruda等核心藥物持續貢獻穩定營收
ai_view:
訊號中性偏正：本季雖帳面虧損，但虧損幅度優於預期13%，且營收仍年增近5%，研判虧損來自一次性費用而非本業惡化。短期股價對「優於預期的虧損」反應或偏中性，須細究費用性質。中期核心仍在Keytruda專利懸崖前的管線佈局。追蹤指標：Keytruda營收、新藥與併購管線進展、調整後（非GAAP）獲利、毛利率與全年指引。

需留意：本季帳面虧損反映一次性費用，獲利能見度短期受擾；Keytruda專利懸崖（約2028年）為長期結構性風險；管線接棒能否填補Keytruda缺口是關鍵不確定性

summary_en:
Merck posted a loss but beat by 13% with 4.9% revenue growth, as one-off items hit reported earnings.
• Loss per share of $1.28 beat the expected $1.47 loss by 13.15%
• Revenue of $16.29B grew 4.87%, with core revenue still expanding
• The loss likely stems from one-off items such as M&A or R&D milestones, not core deterioration
• Keytruda and other core drugs keep contributing steady revenue

ai_view_en:
Signal is neutral-to-positive: despite a reported loss, the shortfall was 13% smaller than feared and revenue still grew ~5%, suggesting the loss came from one-off items rather than core deterioration. Near-term the stock's reaction to a 'better-than-feared loss' may be muted, pending the nature of the charges. Mid-term the core remains pipeline build-out ahead of Keytruda's patent cliff. Track: Keytruda sales, new-drug and M&A pipeline progress, adjusted (non-GAAP) earnings, gross margin and full-year guidance.

Watch：The reported quarterly loss reflects one-off costs, clouding near-term earnings visibility; Keytruda's patent cliff (around 2028) is a long-term structural risk; Whether the pipeline can fill the Keytruda gap is a key uncertainty
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / 每股虧損1.28美元優於預期虧損1.47美元（超預期13.15%），營收年增4.87%。
